fact-panda: Pandas are native to Asia, where they munch lots of bamboo.
fact-elephant: African elephants live in Africa, the world’s second-largest continent.
fact-kangaroo: Kangaroos are native to Australia and hop on powerful back legs.
fact-bison: American bison live in North America, in wide grasslands.
fact-llama: Llamas come from South America and are at home high in the Andes.
fact-ibex: Alpine ibex live in Europe’s high, rocky Alps.
fact-bananas: Bananas were first grown in Southeast Asia long ago.
fact-watermelon: Wild watermelons first grew in Africa.
fact-lamington: Lamington is a sponge cake treat from Australia.
fact-corn: Corn was first grown in Mexico, in North America.
fact-cacao: Cacao grows in tropical South America and becomes chocolate.
fact-pretzel: Pretzels are a favorite baked treat in many parts of Europe.
fact-great-wall: The Great Wall winds across hills in China, in Asia.
fact-pyramids: The Great Pyramid of Giza stands in Egypt, in Africa.
fact-sydney-opera-house: The Sydney Opera House sits beside the harbor in Australia.
fact-statue-of-liberty: The Statue of Liberty stands in New York, in North America.
fact-machu-picchu: Machu Picchu sits high in Peru’s Andes, in South America.
fact-eiffel-tower: The Eiffel Tower stands in Paris, France, in Europe.
